scams.name: Mexico City Benito Juárez Airport (MEX) Taxi Overcharge & 'Authorized Only' Scam
scams.avoidance: Use official Sitio Taxi desk inside arrivals — MX$ 250–MX$ 330 flat-rate prepaid Book Uber/Didi on airport Wi-Fi after luggage — meet at signposted zone NEVER hand credit card to any taxi driver — cash or in-app only Take Metrobús Línea 4 to Centro Histórico for budget — MX$ 30 (35 min, daytime) Confirm driver's printed receipt matches quoted fare before loading
scams.location: Benito Juárez International Airport (MEX) Terminals 1 & 2 arrivals, 'Sitio Taxi' authorized counters, Mexibus/Ecobus queues, Colonia Roma/Condesa/Polanco drop-off zones

scams.name: CDMX Uber/Didi Cancellation & Route-Gaming Credit-Card Scam
scams.avoidance: Pay in-app only — link credit card to Uber/Didi before travel Verify license plate matches app before boarding Cancel any driver requesting WhatsApp or off-app payment; rebook Never hand physical card to driver — tap-to-pay in-app only Watch route on your phone during ride; refuse unjustified detours
scams.location: Roma Norte (Av. Insurgentes Sur, Plaza Río de Janeiro), Condesa (Av. Tamaulipas, Parque México), Polanco (Av. Presidente Masaryk), Centro Histórico Plaza Garibaldi late-night pickups, Zona Rosa nightlife, airport (MEX) departure curb, Angel de la Independencia tourist area

scams.name: Zócalo & Centro Histórico Pickpocket / Phone-Snatch Ring
scams.avoidance: Wear crossbody bag with zipper plus money belt; no back-pocket wallets Keep one card plus daily cash in separate pocket; passport in hotel safe Never put phone on outdoor café table; zipped bag between uses Use Metrobús instead during rush-hour Metro, or hold bag across chest Save Tourist Police (INFOTUR) English line: +52 55 4891 1166
scams.location: Zócalo central plaza, Bellas Artes metro/plaza, Palacio Postal, Calle Madero pedestrian strip, Alameda Central, Metro Line 1/2/3 stations

scams.name: Fake/Corrupt Police Document-Check Bribe Shakedown in CDMX
scams.avoidance: Ask for badge with name and number; write it down immediately Say 'quiero hablar con el consulado' and '911 por favor' NEVER surrender passport — show laminated photocopy only Never unlock phone for any officer; never pay cash on the spot Save US Embassy +52 55 8526 2561 and Policía Turística CDMX (English) +52 55 4891 1166
scams.location: Roma Norte bar/restaurant zones, Condesa late-night sidewalks, Zócalo at night, Polanco tourist hotspots, Coyoacán weekend evenings

scams.name: CDMX Express-Kidnapping (Secuestro Exprés) at ATMs & Forced-Withdrawal
scams.avoidance: Use only bank-branch ATMs during business hours (9 AM–4 PM Mon–Fri) NEVER withdraw from standalone street ATMs, especially at night Set low daily withdrawal limit MX$ 3,000; enable real-time alerts Refuse 'home currency rate' ATM prompt — always proceed in MX$ Carry dedicated travel debit card; save US Embassy 24-hr +52 55 8526 2561
scams.location: Standalone street-corner ATMs late-night, Polanco/Roma taxi drop-offs to 'nearby ATM', Pino Suárez/Insurgentes ATM corridors, hotel-adjacent ATMs

scams.name: TAPO/Central del Norte Bus Terminal Taxi & Counterfeit-Ticket Scam
scams.avoidance: Book Uber/Didi on main street outside terminal — MX$ 120–MX$ 250 Buy bus tickets only at official counter or ADO.com/Primera Plus Never hand credit card to sitio counter — in-app or cash only Refuse 'help with bags' except from badged ADO/OCC staff Use TAPO's signposted Uber pickup zone — not the taxi queue
scams.location: TAPO (Eastern) Bus Terminal, Central del Norte (Northern) Bus Terminal, Central del Sur Tasqueña, taxi queues outside terminals, 'Autobus Ejecutivo' ticket counters
